subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose "No error'.

A major concern is the decline in forest area in places that has good forest cover.

options.text: A major concern is the decline

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the word "**has**" instead of "**have**."
 
• The subject "**places**" is plural, and therefore, it should be followed by the plural verb "**have**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**places that have good forest cover**," ensuring **grammatical correctness and clarity.**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A major concern is the decline in forest area in places** that have good forest cover."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "A major concern is the decline,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "in forest area in places,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
